# freshdesk_agent (Resource)

An agent who works on tickets.

~> Deleting this resource downgrades the agent to a contact rather than removing the person from the helpdesk, which is what the Freshdesk API does.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "freshdesk_roles" "all" {}

locals {
  agent_role = one([
    for r in data.freshdesk_roles.all.roles : r.id if r.name == "Agent"
  ])
}

resource "freshdesk_agent" "sam" {
  email        = "sam@example.com"
  name         = "Sam Okafor"
  ticket_scope = 2
  occasional   = false
  role_ids     = [local.agent_role]
  group_ids    = [freshdesk_group.billing.id]
  signature    = "<p>Sam &mdash; Billing</p>"
}

resource "freshdesk_group" "billing" {
  name = "Billing"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String) Email address of the agent. Changing it forces a new agent, because Freshdesk does not allow it to be updated through the API.

-> Freshdesk stores addresses folded to lower case. This attribute compares case-insensitively.
- `role_ids` (Set of Number) IDs of the roles granted to the agent. At least one is required.
- `ticket_scope` (Number) Ticket permission: `1` global access, `2` group access, `3` restricted to assigned tickets.

### Optional

- `agent_type` (Number) Agent type: `1` support agent, `2` field agent, `3` collaborator.
- `contribution_group_ids` (Set of Number) IDs of groups the agent has view-only access to. Only meaningful when `ticket_scope` is `2`.
- `focus_mode` (Boolean) Whether focus mode is enabled for the agent.
- `group_ids` (Set of Number) IDs of the groups the agent belongs to.
- `language` (String) Language code of the agent, for example `en`.
- `name` (String) Display name of the agent. Changing it forces a new agent: Freshdesk only accepts a name when the agent is created, and it is otherwise managed in the Neo Admin Center.
- `occasional` (Boolean) Whether the agent is occasional rather than full-time.
- `signature` (String) Email signature of the agent, in HTML.
- `skill_ids` (Set of Number) IDs of the skills assigned to the agent.
- `time_zone` (String) Time zone of the agent. Defaults to the helpdesk's.

### Read-Only

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the agent has activated their account.
- `available` (Boolean) Whether the agent is accepting omniroute assignments.
- `created_at` (String) When the agent was created (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Numeric identifier of the agent.
- `job_title` (String) Job title, managed in the Neo Admin Center.
- `last_login_at` (String) When the agent last signed in (RFC 3339).
- `mobile` (String) Mobile number, managed in the Neo Admin Center.
- `phone` (String) Phone number, managed in the Neo Admin Center.
- `type` (String) Agent type in string form, as reported by the API.
- `updated_at` (String) When the agent was last changed (RFC 3339).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by numeric ID.
terraform import freshdesk_agent.example 42
```
